scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd src/client tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && bun run --cwd src/client tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && bun run --cwd src/shared tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd src/client tsc --noEmit -p ../../tsconfig.e2e.json && bun run --cwd src/client tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.lint: bun --bun biome check src/ tests/ scripts/ playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: bun --bun biome check --write src/ tests/ scripts/ playwright.config.ts
scripts.setup: cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit && echo 'pre-commit hook installed'
scripts.test: bun test && bun run test:mock && bun run test:app
scripts.test:mock: for f in $(find src -name '*.mock-test.tsx'); do bun test ./$f || exit 1; done
